nodes.label: Optional Admin Credentials
nodes.rationale: Lets service actions run under a specific account so the interactive user need not be an admin; includes a Test button to validate before saving.

nodes.label: %AppData%\ServiceTrayMonitor\config.json
nodes.rationale: Plain JSON so it can be edited by hand.

nodes.label: Self-Contained Single-File Publish
nodes.rationale: Produces a standalone win-x64 exe runnable without the SDK installed.

nodes.label: UAC Admin Token Filtering (Access is denied)
nodes.norm_label: uac admin token filtering (access is denied)
nodes.rationale: Windows filters the admin token when a process is launched with explicit alternate credentials, even for Administrators group members.

nodes.label: Built-in Administrator Account Workaround
nodes.rationale: The built-in Administrator account is not subject to UAC filtering.

nodes.label: DPAPI Password Encryption
nodes.rationale: Password is never written to disk in plain text and is only decryptable by the same Windows user account.

nodes.label: requireAdministrator Manifest / UAC Elevation
nodes.rationale: Starting, stopping and pausing services requires elevation, so the app requests admin via UAC at launch.

nodes.label: Runtime-Drawn Icons
nodes.rationale: No external image files, so nothing can go missing when the app is moved.

nodes.label: Per-Service ACL Grant via sc sdset (Least Privilege)
nodes.norm_label: per-service acl grant via sc sdset (least privilege)
nodes.rationale: Recommended fix: grant the account's SID Start/Stop/Pause/Query rights on specific services so it never needs admin membership.
